name: Rind Cultist
note: A member of the Order of the Sacred Rind, convinced the Grand Wheel is the earthly body of their goat god and that eating it is a holy sacrament, not a theft. Loud, self-righteous, and completely innocent of this particular crime — they wanted to eat the cheese themselves, not hide it in a sewer.

abilities.name: "The Wheel Provides"
abilities.desc: Shouted as a battle cry. Purely for morale, mechanically does nothing, deeply annoying.
